feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, dropped sharply overnight
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 46 centimetres on 30 October, down 12 centimetres from 58 centimetres the previous day. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, direct reading, 30 October 2026

entry.title: England's drought body set a rainfall target to avoid the drought continuing into 2027
entry.summary: The Environment Agency told the National Drought Group on 28 October that England has received only 61 percent of its expected rainfall this year and needs at least full average rainfall between now and March 2027 to avoid the drought continuing into next year. — Sources: Environment Agency, National Drought Group meeting, 28 October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze held moderate for a fifth consecutive day, at a softer reading
entry.summary: Singapore's National Environment Agency recorded a 24-hour PSI of 55 to 60 across all five regions at 1pm local time, moderate everywhere for a fifth day running, though lower than the 69 to 78 range recorded the previous day. — Sources: National Environment Agency, Singapore, direct reading, 30 October 2026, 1pm SGT
